summary: GET /transactions/{id} is in the contract, implemented through a read-only use case and a JdbcClient read side, mapped to 404/400 Problem Details. Order-by-posting-id is documented on the schema and the use case. Microsecond truncation is unit-tested. Build 161/161, mutation 55/55.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: ledger-api.yaml: GET /transactions/{transactionId} with 200 Transaction, 400 BadRequest, 404 NotFound; lines order documented
GetTransactionService (readOnly), TransactionPersistenceAdapter.findById with order by p.id; GetTransactionServiceTest; TransactionPersistenceAdapterIT

findings.description: The line-order assertion sorts posting ids as lowercase text, relying on PostgreSQL uuid byte order matching text order; true but implicit, and it only gets exercised when random ids differ from request order.
findings.suggestion: Optional: note it in the adapter IT or keep as is.
